column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Date Arc
W-Where do we... go next?
You sure try hard.
T-This is for Kirino's... No, this is for my own sake.
How about taking a little break?
I'm fine. Let's go to the next place.
She's going all in here.
I really want to take a break... but she wouldn't listen even if I asked.
Well, let's go have lunch at the shop Kirino usually goes to.
Please enjoy yourselves① Master, Mistress.
Here is the menu.
Ah, thanks.
Um... Onii-san?
W-What's going on? Is this shop...
It's a maid cafe.
M-Maid cafe?
Yeah. A cafe where they have cute maids serving the customers.
Which would mean... that what all the waitresses are wearing is...
Maid costumes.
...Were maid costumes always that frilly?
Don't fret over the minor details.
Anyway, when you think Akiba, you think maid cafes.
R-Really? ...T-Then I'll have to savor this opportunity.
Well, this was a pretty neat excuse to get Ayase to take a break.
W-Wow... I never would have thought there was a shop like this here.
Ayase was looking around restlessly, seemingly unable to settle down.
That's probably how I reacted when I first came here.
...But then I somehow got used to it.
So, what do you want to eat?
Even if you say that... I don't really understand what's on the menu.
Ah, right. I didn't get it when I first came here either.
Well, you okay with omelette rice and black tea?
Yes.
Okay. Excuse me!
...Y-You're quite familiar with this, aren't you?
Eh?
...Do you go to shops like this often?
N-No! I-I don't!
Ah! Onii-chan! You came back again～①
Kirara is happy that you're coming so often lately, Onii-chan♪
Geh...
Hmm...
I-It's not like that, Ayase! Please listen to me!
Why exactly is this Maid-san here calling you 'Onii-chan'?
That, Mistress♪, is because our shop offers the service to have you, the customers, decide for yourself how we should address you～
The first time you come to our shop, you get to decide what we are supposed to call you♪
And you chose 'Onii-chan'?!
There are many reasons for that!!!
D-Damn this maid...! She's ruining my already bad image!
But really, 'Onii-chan'? You're obviously â â  years older than me!
Hehe, Mistress, how would you like us to address you?
...I-It's fine as it is.
Certainly, Mistress♪
This maid is called Hoshino Kirara.
Though it doesn't really require explaining, she's one of the maids at the Pretty Garden cafe that Kirino and I often visit..
Then we'd like two sets of omelette rice and black tea.
Yes☆
So you're here with a different girl today, Onii-chan♪
You're doing this on purpose aren't you!
Ehehehe～
What is this all about, Onii-san?
Look, it's just one big misunderstanding! What can I do?
Hmm... But you know, the Lieutenant seems pretty curious about this.
Huh? The Lieutenant? Who's this Lieutenant?
She's a regular customer here. Want me to call for her?
Eh? ...S-Sure...
I really have no clue who this Lieutenant is supposed to be.
Lieutenant! Onii-chan is calling for you♪
Yes, yes! Lieutenant Saori Bajeena is right here!
You're the Lieutenant?!
I-I see! Since she's a regular customer here, it's not so strange that she would be here.
O... O-O-O... Onii-san... D-Do you know her?
Seeing up close how tall Saori was, Ayase started shuddering.
Well...
H-How am I supposed to explain this...?
